LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.0.label: sharing a bed with master (revulsion)
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.0.descrip: Sleeping in the same bed as my master fills me with humiliation and disgust. Just being close makes me want to get away.
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.1.label: sharing a bed with master (resistance)
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.1.descrip: Sharing a bed with my master still repulses me on instinct. That lingering disgust refuses to fade away.
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.2.label: sharing a bed with master (wavering)
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.2.descrip: I should be resisting this, yet my body and emotions are beginning to betray me. The closer I am to my master, the harder that dangerous sense of comfort is to ignore.
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.3.label: sharing a bed with master (tamed)
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.3.descrip: Lying beside my master makes me relax without thinking. The feeling of being possessed and controlled is starting to feel comforting.
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.4.label: sharing a bed with master (obsessed)
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.4.descrip: Only when I sleep close to my master do I feel truly at ease. My master's bed, scent, and warmth are becoming impossible to give up.
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.5.label: sharing a bed with master (fully broken)
LanguageData.SSC_SharedBedWithMaster.stages.5.descrip: Falling asleep pressed against my master fills me with overwhelming satisfaction. My resistance has already been crushed, and now I only want to sink deeper into my master's control.
